decision_subjects.question: Which successful commands announce?
decision_subjects.recommendation: Announce deploy and rollback, since both activate committed skill content through the same apply boundary. Never announce check, plan, status or retire. This includes a successful redeploy with no effective content change, explicitly labelled as such.

decision_subjects.question: What counts as actually changed installed skills?
decision_subjects.recommendation: Report per-target added, content-changed and removed managed names, plus a sorted deduplicated affected-name list. Snapshot actual visible installed content before switching under the release lock and compare with the new effective exported directories, after their own exclusions. New availability and managed removals are explicit; uninstalled skill edits and byte-identical retargets are not content changes. Keep-link content deltas count. Apply the new exclusions only to the new export, never retroactively to the old snapshot.
decision_subjects.owner: human, with coordinator resolving bounded interpretation before dispatch

decision_subjects.question: How are publication failure, no-op and retry represented?
decision_subjects.recommendation: Only attempt publication after apply returns successfully (verification plus history append). Preserve that successful deployment on notification error. Emit the successful deployment JSON with a separate announcement result; return 0 when confirmed, 3 when deployment succeeded but publication is unconfirmed, and preserve existing deployment/usage failure statuses. Include the intended payload, precise error and manual existing-board retry guidance when unconfirmed. Each successful activation command, including no-op deploy, attempts one announcement. No automatic replay, scheduler, outbox or exactly-once claim. A manual retry may duplicate a prior unconfirmed post; do not rerun rollback merely to retry notification.

decision_subjects.question: Which publisher identity, repository and topic are used?
decision_subjects.recommendation: Publish into the canonical repository resolved from --repository, not the script checkout or release root. Use the existing ordinary post CLI from the resolved sibling released durable-state skill, author skill-release, topic all, and a fresh UUID explicitly representing this tool invocation as session_id. Do not infer a verified agent session from inherited environment. Include full release commit, action, completion time, affected names by target, release location and concise reload guidance. Preserve the publication message/revision on confirmed success. No new CLI flags or board schema.
decision_subjects.owner: human/coordinator; board semantic owner if its identity policy requires an agent runtime

decision_subjects.question: What isolated evidence is sufficient?
decision_subjects.recommendation: All deployment and board mutations occur only in temporary repositories, release directories, targets and backups; use the real existing board CLI for success tests. Cover initial install, kept links with changed content, managed removal, uninstalled edits, exclusion transitions, no-op redeploy, rollback and failure/no-publication boundaries. Inject deterministic publication failures to prove successful release state and exit 3. Include a copied/released-path smoke proving sibling-helper resolution and the exact target repository. Run the existing release suite and CLI-synopsis freshness check after authorization.
